messages:
alex: quick heads-up, hit a repeatable ESM/CJS parity bug when bundling the JS SDK for an edge sample app (vite + rollup). build passes but edge worker throws: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')`.

alex: project uses "type": "module" and simple import: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`. bundle looks fine locally but fails in the edge runtime.

alex: package exports look like: { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" }.

jamie: sounds like the bundler ended up pulling the cjs wrapper into an ESM runtime. some vite/esbuild versions do that when conditional exports are present.

riley: workaround that helped #1: alias to the explicit ESM file in vite config `alias: {'@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js'}` — ugly but unblocks devs.

alex: aliasing fixes the runtime but breaks the expectation of a frictionless sample app. onboarding hits this on first run.

samir: types also mis-resolve for `import type { Client } from '@redwood/inference'` in some TS setups. suggest ensuring top-level `types` or an `exports.types` mapping next to the esm entry.

taylor: short-term: can we add a note in sample-app README with the alias + repro steps so new hires aren't blocked?

jamie: long-term SDK actions: 1) validate `exports` shape across vite/esbuild/rollup resolvers, 2) add a `module` field or exports fallback that favors ESM for bundlers, 3) make typings discoverable for `import type`, 4) add a CI job that builds sample apps with vite and runs an edge smoke test.

alex: opened RED-PLAT/SDK#1428 (placeholder) with logs and a minimal repro repo link. deploy-bot: New issue created: RED-PLAT/SDK#1428 by alex  "ESM/CJS parity causes edge runtime prototype error with vite".

riley: also include both import styles in the repro: `import Redwood from`, `import * as Redwood`, and `const Redwood = require()` to catch differences.

samir: agreed. i'll add a small PR template for SDK issues asking for bundler matrix results and a sample-app smoke test.

taylor: thanks all. adding the README note + alias now. once SDK fixes package layout, we'll remove the workaround and add migration notes for pinned versions.

alex: will update thread with PR numbers and the SDK patch when available.
